requirement: When `output.html.git-repository-url` names a GitHub repository and `output.html.edit-url-template` uses that repository's `/edit/<branch>/{path}` form, each safely resolved source location displayed for an evidence input MUST link its repository-relative file and inclusive line range to `/blob/<branch>/<file>#L<start>-L<end>`. A source location MUST remain plain text when a safe URL cannot be derived. A generated detail page MUST use its evidence JSON file as the mdBook edit target when the file exists, or its requirement chapter when the evidence file is missing.
rationale: The marked tests cover each obligation in `requirements.index.source_links`. **Link derivation from a matching GitHub repository and branch.** `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[source_links_use_configured_repository_and_branch]` builds `SourceLinks` from a config with `git-repository-url` and an `/edit/release/{path}` template. - It asserts `input_url("src/evidence.rs", 26, 37)` equals `https://github.com/example/project/blob/release/src/evidence.rs#L26-L37`. That checks the `/blob//#L-L` form and the inclusive range. - It asserts that a path with a space and `#` is percent-encoded. - It asserts that the same config under `output.habeas.html` gives the same links. - It renders a real detail page through `render_detail_page` with an outline input. The page contains `src/evidence.rs:26–37`, so the link is applied to the displayed location. - Every location kind goes through `render_source_location`, so one rendering path serves all of them. **Plain text when no safe URL can be derived.** - `input_url` returns None for `../outside.rs` and for start line 0. - `from_config` returns None when the template repository differs from `git-repository-url`. - `from_config` returns None for `javascript:` URLs. - `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[detail_page_shows_recorded_text_locations_and_first_matching_group]` renders detail pages with no source links configured. It asserts the locations appear as plain `md/rules.md:5–7` and `md/rules.md:9–13` items. - `render_source_location` has a single `url` Option branch. Both a missing configuration and a None URL take that plain branch, so the plain-text outcome is asserted for it. **Edit target.** - `evidence_edit_path` is asserted directly: `docs/md` gives `../../evidence/requirements.core.ready.json`. - `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters]` asserts that the `ready` page, which has an evidence file, has `source_path` `../evidence/requirements.core.ready.json`. - The same test asserts that the `absent` page, which has no evidence file, has `source_path` `requirements/core.md`, the requirement chapter. I found no unmarked relevant tests and no unacknowledged gaps. Other unusual inputs would only exercise the same branches the tests already hit, so I do not count them as gaps. Examples are an end line below the start line, or a template that lacks `/edit/`.
